category.description: The product category. Extract high-level types here (e.g., 'notebook' -> 'LAPTOP').

maxPrice.description: The numeric maximum price limit from terms like 'under $500', 'cheap', 'budget'.

minPrice.description: The numeric minimum price limit from terms like 'over $100', 'premium'.

inStockOnly.description: True if the user explicitly asks for availability (e.g. 'in stock', 'ready to ship').
